name: regex_grouping1.k
model:
class RegexGrouping1 {
  repeated:String

  req repeated = "ababab"

  req repeated.matches("(ab)+")
  spelling1:String

  req spelling1 = "color"

  req spelling1.matches("colou?r")
  spelling2:String

  req spelling2 = "colour"

  req spelling2.matches("colou?r")
  prefix1:String

  req prefix1 = "test"

  req prefix1.matches("(un)?test")
  prefix2:String

  req prefix2 = "untest"

  req prefix2.matches("(un)?test")
}

main:RegexGrouping1
